Several days (7 bosses; each boss room only once per 20 h)

In the {wiki:Halls of Hope|Halls of Hope}, north of Thais, {npc:Albinius} guards a temple of the ancient Astral Shapers. Hand him {item:Heavy Old Tome|Heavy Old Tomes} so you can use the {item:Imbuing Shrine|Imbuing Shrines}, then go through the six elemental portals (energy, death, ice, earth, fire and holy), kill the boss of each one and, at the end, face {creature:The Last Lore Keeper}. Each boss unlocks the **Powerful** tier imbuements of its element.
Forgotten knowledge from ancient times can be recovered to allow Imbuing again.
Halls of Hope, north of Thais
No minimum level, but the **recommended level is 200** (all the portals have strong bosses).
{wiki:The New Frontier Quest} completed, including mission 9 (Mortal Combat), so you can enter the Fire Portal.
{wiki:The Ice Islands Quest} done at least up to the *The Contactman* mission (access to the {wiki:Formorgar Mines}), for the Ice Portal.
A team of 1 to 5 players for each of the six bosses and 1 to 15 players for the final boss.
so Albinius lets you use the Imbuing Shrines
obtained in the quest itself (Earth Portal)
recommended for the Fire Portal boss
to protect the egg in the Ice Portal
to climb back up through the holes of the Ice Portal and the Astral Shaper Boss Dungeon
Access to {wiki:Imbuing|Imbuing} (first two tiers by handing in the 5 tomes; the third tier — **Powerful** — is unlocked boss by boss)
Powerful imbuements for elemental protection, elemental damage, skills, mana leech, life leech and critical hit
The bosses drop pieces of the {item:Astral Shaper Rune}, which you can use to tame the {wiki:Stone Rhino (Mount)|Stone Rhino} mount
in the Holy Portal's Room of Cleansing
When you hand the {item:Heavy Old Tome|Heavy Old Tomes} to {npc:Albinius} ({key:temple}): you can now use the {item:Imbuing Shrine|Imbuing Shrines}.
If your world's temple is already restored, 5 tomes are enough.
Boss by boss: when you kill the boss of each elemental portal and use the {wiki:Abandoned Imbuing Shrine} in the area, you unlock the Powerful imbuements of that element.
Elemental protection, elemental damage, skills, mana leech, life leech and critical hit.
Elemental portals of the Halls of Hope (Energy, Death, Ice, Earth, Fire and Holy)
With the temple restored, each portal (except fire) is paid for once to {npc:Albinius} with 50 items.
The Fire Portal only lets through those who have completed the whole {wiki:The New Frontier Quest}; the Ice Portal requires {wiki:The Ice Islands Quest} up to *The Contactman*.
For the Energy Portal: {key:energy portal} to {npc:Albinius} and 50 {item:Marsh Stalker Feather|Marsh Stalker Feathers}.
For the Death Portal: {key:death portal} to {npc:Albinius} and 50 {item:Pelvis Bone|Pelvis Bones}.
For the Holy Portal: {key:holy portal} to {npc:Albinius} and 50 {item:Incantation Notes}.
After killing the **six bosses** of the elemental portals, the {wiki:Energy Gate} of the Halls of Hope lets you through.
The portal bosses drop pieces of the {item:Astral Shaper Rune}, with which you can tame a {creature:Stone Rhino}.
The six portals can be done in any order; the final boss ({creature:The Last Lore Keeper}) only becomes accessible after you have killed all six.
Each character can only enter each boss room **once every 20 hours**. Plan for several days.
Collect the 50 items for each portal before going to the temple: {item:Marsh Stalker Feather}, {item:Pelvis Bone}, {item:Fish}, {item:Acorn} and {item:Incantation Notes}.
After each boss, don't forget to use the {wiki:Abandoned Imbuing Shrine} in the area: that is what unlocks the Powerful imbuements of that element.
1. The temple of the Halls of Hope
It all starts at the Astral Shapers' temple, in the Halls of Hope, north of Thais. This is where Albinius, Ivalisse and the six portals are.
Going to the Halls of Hope

Walk to the **Halls of Hope**, north of **Thais**: leave the city by the **north** exit and keep going north to the Astral Shapers' temple, where {npc:Albinius} and {npc:Ivalisse} are. To return, take the same path **south** to Thais.

Each portal takes you far away: Energy and Holy to beneath {wiki:Tiquanda}, Death to the {wiki:Old Masonry} (north of Ulderek's Rock), Ice to the {wiki:Formorgar Mines}, Earth to near the {wiki:Outlaw Camp} and Fire to {wiki:Zao}. In each of those areas there is a portal of the same element, where you arrive, that brings you back to the Halls of Hope: remember where you appeared so you know how to get back.

You need {item:Heavy Old Tome|Heavy Old Tomes}. You find them in {item:Brass-Shod Chest|Brass-Shod Chests} at the locations in the table, or as loot from {creature:Cyclops}, several kinds of {wiki:Orcs|orcs}, {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}, {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons} and {creature:Troll|Trolls}.
Basement of the tower near Mount Sternum
House outside the Mount Sternum Undead Cave
Path to the orcs in the Ancient Temple
Basement (floor -1) of the tower near {wiki:Mount Sternum}
House outside the {wiki:Mount Sternum Undead Cave}
Path to the orcs in the {wiki:Ancient Temple}
Handing the tomes over to Albinius

Talk to {npc:Albinius}: say {key:hi}, {key:temple} and {key:yes}. He takes **all** the tomes you have in your backpack. On a new world the temple starts unfinished and enough tomes have to be handed in (among all the players) for him to restore it. If the temple is already restored, you just need to give him **5 tomes** to be allowed to use the {item:Imbuing Shrine|Imbuing Shrines}.
You can use the Imbuing Shrines (first two tiers of imbuing)
The third tier (Powerful) only becomes available element by element, as you kill the portal bosses.

With the temple restored, **six portals** appear, each connected to a zone with a boss: Energy, Death, Ice, Earth, Fire and Holy. For each one (except Fire) you pay 50 items to {npc:Albinius}. Killing each boss and using the zone's shrine unlocks that element's Powerful imbuements. The bosses also drop pieces of the {item:Astral Shaper Rune} ({wiki:Stone Rhino (Mount)|Stone Rhino} mount).
Each character can only enter each boss room once every 20 hours.
Talk to {npc:Albinius} and say {key:energy portal}. He asks for 50 {item:Marsh Stalker Feather|Marsh Stalker Feathers}: hand them over and you can use the portal.
Enter the **Energy Portal**. You appear in the {wiki:Replica Dungeon}, full of {creature:Iron Servant Replica|Iron Servant Replicas}.
Pull the **left** lever. The message *"5 Diamond entities are consuming too much raw energy for the cosmic chamber to awaken, it will be put to rest again in 10 m."* appears.

Pull the **right** lever. *"5 Golden entities are consuming too much pure energy for the cosmic chamber to awaken, it will be put to rest again in 10 m."* appears. From here on, {creature:Golden Servant Replica|Golden} and {creature:Diamond Servant Replica|Diamond Servant Replicas} join the Iron Servants.

Kill at least **5 {creature:Golden Servant Replica|Golden Servant Replicas}** and **5 {creature:Diamond Servant Replica|Diamond Servant Replicas}** in under **10 minutes**. A lava flow and a water flow then start running through the system: follow them to the centre of the dungeon, where an {wiki:Energy Gate} appears.

Servant kills are saved: you can kill them one day and enter the Energy Gate on another, as long as you have not killed Lloyd in the meantime and someone has activated the gate (killed the Servants within the 10 minutes after pulling the levers).
Enter the Energy Gate. You appear in a room with 5 {item:Stone Tile|stone tiles} and a lever. Put the team (1 to 5 players) on the tiles and pull the lever to be taken to the boss room.

In the room are {creature:Lloyd} and four immobile prisms: {creature:Cosmic Energy Prism A}, {creature:Cosmic Energy Prism B|B}, {creature:Cosmic Energy Prism C|C} and {creature:Cosmic Energy Prism D|D}. Kill Lloyd; *"The cosmic energies in the chamber refocus on Lloyd!"* appears. At that moment kill **one** of the prisms. Lloyd reappears: kill him again and then another prism. Repeat until all 4 prisms are dead; only then does Lloyd die for good.

You have **10 minutes** for the fight. When the time is up you are thrown out of the room (you hear *"MY COSMIC HARNESS MAKES ME INVINCIBLE!"*). Lloyd has an electric attack that hits anyone standing near another player: keep away from your teammates.
A good place to trap Lloyd is northeast of Cosmic Energy Prism D; a {item:Wild Growth Rune} helps stop him from switching targets.
After killing Lloyd, use the {wiki:Abandoned Imbuing Shrine} to unlock the Powerful energy imbuements.
Converts 50% of physical damage to energy damage
After the shrine, go back the same way to where you arrived in the {wiki:Replica Dungeon} and enter the {wiki:Energy Portal} there: it takes you back to the Halls of Hope, north of Thais.

You can kill Lloyd again 20 hours after the last time. To do so you have to kill 5 Golden and 5 Diamond Servant Replicas again to be able to enter the Energy Gate, even if it is already open. From then on the dead Servants no longer show up as counted in the Quest Log.
Talk to {npc:Albinius} and say {key:death portal}. He asks for 50 {item:Pelvis Bone|Pelvis Bones}: hand them over and enter the portal.

The **Death Portal** takes you to the {wiki:Old Masonry}. On the upper floors there are {creature:Necromancer|Necromancers}, {creature:Renegade Knight|Renegade Knights} and {creature:Vicious Squire|Vicious Squires}; on the lower ones, {wiki:Astral Shapers}.
Walk **southeast** and go down at this point. There is a scroll here, {wiki:The Ghostsilver Lantern (Book)}, that tells the story of Zegrath and his lantern.
Way down to the next floor
Walk **east** and go up at this point.
In the **northwest** corner of the room there is a {wiki:Spider Web (Quest)|spider web}. Use it (actually, use the floor just before it) and you receive the {item:Ghostsilver Lantern}.
Walk **northeast** and enter a room through a {item:Door (Iron Bars)|barred door}. The message *"As you enter the room you hear a moaning sound. It seemingly comes from an old desk nearby."* appears.
In the middle of the room use the {item:Old Desk}. A ghost appears for a moment and you receive an {item:Old Note}.
Walk **southeast** and use the {item:Heap of Rubbish}. You receive a {item:Painting of a Girl} (*"You have found a painting of a girl."*).
Putting the painting on the desk
Go back to the {item:Old Desk} room and use the {item:Painting of a Girl} on the desk. You hear a jingling inside the drawer.
Use the {item:Old Desk} again and you receive an {item:Old Silver Key} (*"You open the drawer again and find an old silver key that surely wasn't there before."*).

With the lantern and the key, walk **east** until you pass through this wall. *"In the light of the ghostsilver lantern you discover an otherwise invisible door. As you have the fitting key you can pass it."* appears. From now on you can fight the boss.

Take the lantern, **light it** and use the wall: you appear further down. Go through the teleport to reach the pre-boss room. Put the team (1 to 5) on the tiles and pull the lever to face {creature:Lady Tenebris} and her {creature:Shadow Tentacle|Shadow Tentacles}.
If you change your mind and want to leave without fighting: with the lantern lit, use the wall to the **north** of the pre-boss room.

Use **fire** damage; equip **death** protection. First you deal with Lady Tenebris and the Shadow Tentacles. After the tentacles die, she summons {creature:Shadow Fiend|Shadow Fiends}, which hit weakly but paralyse: use {item:Great Fireball Rune|Great Fireball Runes}, waves and maybe {spell:Hell's Core}. Stay focused on Lady Tenebris and clear the Shadow Fiends with area damage.

Every so often she teleports the group to the centre of the room and, seconds later, explodes around her with up to **2500 death damage**. Keep a {item:Stone Skin Amulet} on a hotkey and equip it right after the teleport: the maximum damage drops to about 500 (even less with a {item:Death Ring}/{item:Butterfly Ring} or {item:Moon Mirror}).
After killing Lady Tenebris, use this area's {wiki:Abandoned Imbuing Shrine}.
Converts 50% of physical damage to death damage
Converts 25% of damage to health (100% chance)
Powerful death and life leech imbuements

To leave the boss area, light the {item:Ghostsilver Lantern} and use the wall to the **north** of the pre-boss room (the same exit used by anyone who gives up on the fight). Then retrace your steps through the floors of the {wiki:Old Masonry} (going down and up in the same places) to the arrival point and enter the {wiki:Death Portal} there to return to the Halls of Hope.
Pre-boss room (wall to the north = exit)
Without the lantern lit you cannot pass through the wall: do not throw it away before you leave.
Talk to {npc:Albinius} and say {key:ice portal}. He asks for 50 {item:Fish}: hand them over so you can use the portal.
Go through the **Ice Portal**: you appear in the {wiki:Formorgar Mines}, near Svargrond. Walk **northeast** and go down a hole at this point.
Arrival through the Ice Portal (portal back)
Bring a {item:Rope}: you will have to climb back up through this hole to return to the portal.
Follow the path on the map to {npc:A Dragon Mother}.
Say {key:hi}, {key:assistance}, {key:yes} and {key:egg}. She asks you to recover the egg that the ice creatures stole from her and gives you permission to enter the egg room.

Go back to the portal and walk to this point. Follow the path down to a room with a teleport; enter it and you arrive in a room with a lever. Put the team (1 to 5) on the squares and pull the lever to enter the boss room.
You have **17 minutes** for the fight.

The blocker uses challenge on the {creature:Solid Frozen Horror} while the rest of the team runs **north** to the {creature:Dragon Egg}. Next to the egg there are two {creature:Icicle (Creature)|Icicle} towers: keep a {item:Magic Wall Rune|magic wall} active on each side so they do not hit the egg. Attack the egg with **fire** damage ({item:Great Fireball Rune|Great Fireball Runes}, {spell:Flame Strike}, etc.): this **heals** the egg.
Position of the magic walls to protect the egg from the Icicles
Never use ice attacks on the egg: they lower its health. Equip ice protection.

After a few seconds {creature:Frozen Minion|Frozen Minions} appear. Their ice spells heal the boss and damage the egg, so it is advisable for a paladin to block them, running around the room if necessary. They can be killed, but they reappear shortly afterwards. Keep the Solid Frozen Horror away from the egg: it has an area spell that cancels magic walls and also casts ice waves.

When the egg's health fills up, the message *"The egg sends out a fiery eruption! Weakening the frozen horror significantly!"* appears and the boss turns into a {creature:Melting Frozen Horror}. Attack it quickly with **death** damage (mages: {item:Sudden Death Rune|Sudden Death Runes}). After **20 seconds** it becomes solid again and you have to heat the egg up again. Repeat until you kill it.
Talking to the Dragon Mother again
After you kill the boss a {creature:Baby Dragon (Creature)|Baby Dragon} is born. Go back to {npc:A Dragon Mother} and say {key:hi}: she melts the ice so you can pass.

Leave her room and, instead of going up, follow the cave and enter the {wiki:Mystic Flame}. You arrive in a small dungeon with {creature:Twisted Shaper|Twisted Shapers} and {creature:Shaper Matriarch|Shaper Matriarchs}. Use the {wiki:Abandoned Imbuing Shrine} to the **northeast**.
Converts 50% of physical damage to ice damage

Go back the same way to the tunnel where you arrived: climb up the hole northeast of the portal with the {item:Rope} and enter the {wiki:Ice Portal} in the Formorgar Mines to return to the Halls of Hope. Alternatively, the mines' Hoist takes you to the {wiki:Formorgar Glacier}, near Svargrond.
Ice Portal back to the Halls of Hope
Talk to {npc:Albinius} and say {key:earth portal}. He asks for 50 {item:Acorn|Acorns}: hand them over and enter the portal.
Talking to the Weakened Forest Fury

Go through the **Earth Portal** (or walk to the {wiki:Outlaw Camp}, between Thais and Venore) and look for the {npc:Weakened Forest Fury}, by the {wiki:Stony Pond} a little southwest of where the portal drops you. Say {key:hi}, {key:distress} and {key:yes}. She gives you an {item:Empty Birdcage}.
Arrival through the Earth Portal (portal back)

**Use** the {wiki:Stony Pond} next to the Forest Fury to get a {item:Phial of Fresh Water} (*"A phial of fresh pond water. It looks crystal clear and sparkles a little."*). You will need it to water the birches and heal the giant tree.

**Walk** into the Stony Pond. You appear in the {wiki:Desecrated Glade}, where there are {creature:Cave Parrot|Cave Parrots}, {creature:Orclops Ravager|Orclops Ravagers} and {creature:Orclops Doomhauler|Orclops Doomhaulers}.
Use the {item:Empty Birdcage} on a {creature:Cave Parrot}. It gets trapped and the cage becomes an {item:Occupied Birdcage}.
Freeing the parrot at the Giant Tree

Go down a few floors until you see the {wiki:Giant Tree}. Use the {item:Occupied Birdcage} and the parrot flies away (*"You open the cage and let the cave parrot roam free!"*). Repeat both steps until you have freed **3 parrots**.

Kill {creature:Orclops Ravager|Orclops Ravagers} until you get {item:Reinvigorating Seeds} (you only need one). Use them on a {item:Fertile Soil}: a {item:Growing Birch} appears (*"You planted some seeds into the soil."*).
Use the {item:Phial of Fresh Water} on the {item:Growing Birch}; it grows and becomes a {item:Blooming Birch}. You have to grow **5 birches** in total.
Go back to the {wiki:Giant Tree} and use the {item:Phial of Fresh Water} on it to "heal" it. A {wiki:Mystic Flame} appears in front of you.

Enter the Mystic Flame. You appear in a cave of {item:Tree Wall|Tree Walls} deep beneath {wiki:Tiquanda}. Walk **northwest** to a teleport and enter it. You arrive in a room with 5 {item:Stone Tile|stone tiles} and a lever: put the team (1 to 5) on the tiles and pull the lever. The boss room is a little to the west.
Arrival at the Tree Walls cave

On entering, 8 {creature:Possessed Tree|Possessed Trees}, the {creature:Mounted Thorn Knight} and up to 4 {creature:Thorn Minion|Thorn Minions} appear. When the trees die, they turn into {creature:Unbound Blightwalker}, {creature:Unbound Defiler}, {creature:Unbound Demon Outcast} or {creature:Unbound Demon}. You can kill them one by one (the knight then takes more damage) or stay in the **south** and avoid killing them. The knight has 3 phases: 1) mounted, summons Thorn Minions; 2) becomes {creature:The Shielded Thorn Knight} with the {creature:Thorn Steed} mount, which you have to kill first; 3) becomes {creature:The Enraged Thorn Knight}. All forms take **fire** damage.
**Do not use death damage**: it heals them for 10 times the damage (an SD that would hit for 500 heals 5000). Equip physical and earth protection.
After killing The Enraged Thorn Knight, use the {wiki:Abandoned Imbuing Shrine} on the west side of the boss room.
Converts 50% of physical damage to earth damage
Powerful earth and melee skill imbuements

The boss room is deep beneath {wiki:Tiquanda}, far from where you came in, and the wiki does not describe an exit of its own. Go back the same way (teleport, {item:Tree Wall|Tree Walls} cave and Mystic Flame) to the {wiki:Desecrated Glade}, climb up to the {wiki:Stony Pond} next to the {npc:Weakened Forest Fury} and enter the {wiki:Earth Portal} at the Outlaw Camp to return to the Halls of Hope.
Arrival at the Tree Walls cave
Earth Portal back to the Halls of Hope
For the Fire Portal you do not pay any items: {npc:Ivalisse} gives you the mission. You need {wiki:The New Frontier Quest} completed to enter the portal.

In the **Halls of Hope**, talk to {npc:Ivalisse}: {key:hi}, {key:temple} (or {key:mission}), {key:father}, {key:yes}, {key:yes}. She asks you to find her father, Silus, who went to study the {wiki:Draken} in {wiki:Zao}.

Enter the **Fire Portal** (only those who have done the whole The New Frontier Quest can pass). You appear in the north of **Zao**, in the {wiki:Muggy Plains}, next to a Fire Portal that takes you back to the Halls of Hope.
**East** of the building go up some stairs, walk **north** over a {wiki:Bridge|bridge} and enter the {wiki:Temple Complex}.

Walk **south**, past {creature:Mutated Bat|Mutated Bats} and {creature:Mutated Tiger|Mutated Tigers}, and go **west** through the lizard area ({wiki:High Class Lizards}). Keep going until you can go down a floor and head **northeast**. You arrive at a room with {npc:A Strange Chalice}: it is Silus, in disguise.
Using the teleport with the password
Stand on the teleport and say {key:zzubaran}. You go down a floor and arrive in an area with {creature:Draken Warmaster|Draken Warmasters} and {creature:Draken Spellweaver|Draken Spellweavers}.
Walk **south** to another teleport; it takes you to a room a little to the west with several {item:Stone Tile|stone tiles} and a lever.
If another group is in the room, you cannot enter. If you leave the room in the middle of the fight, you cannot re-enter straight away.

Gather 1 to 5 people and pull the lever. In the room there are 4 {creature:Soulcatcher|Soulcatchers} (immobile object creatures), 2 {creature:Dragon Servant|Dragon Servants} and {creature:Dragonking Zyrtarch} (immortal). The knight stands in the **centre** and keeps the Dragonking away from the Soulcatchers (they heal him if he is near). The rest of the team attacks the Soulcatchers with damage-over-time spells: {spell:Inflict Wound}, {spell:Curse}, {spell:Electrify}, {spell:Envenom}, {spell:Holy Flash}, {spell:Ignite} or {item:Soulfire Rune|Soulfire Runes} (the Soulcatchers are not immune to fire). This is how {creature:Corrupted Soul|Corrupted Souls} spawn.
Bring about **50 {item:Soulfire Rune|Soulfire Runes}**: they make it much easier to spawn the Corrupted Souls, without waiting for spell cooldowns.

Kill the **three** Corrupted Souls **on the same square** to create the portal to the room below. The first vortex is **green** ({item:Vortex (Green)}), the second **purple** ({item:Vortex (Purple)}) and the last **red** ({item:Vortex (Red)}).
When the vortex turns red, the whole team enters it, **shooters first**: they fall to the room below. The knight lures the Dragonking onto the vortex and only then jumps in himself.
Make sure the boss goes through the red vortex **before** the knight jumps. If all 5 jump without the boss, use the teleport below to return to the room and try again.
Teleport back to the room above

Down below you face the mortal form, {creature:Soul of Dragonking Zyrtarch}, with 2 {creature:Dragon Wrath|Dragon Wraths}. Attack with **death** damage (SDs). The shooters create a safer zone away from the centre with {spell:Fire Bomb} or {spell:Energy Bomb} (the Dragon Wraths cannot pass through those fields) and the knight keeps the boss and the 2 dragons in the middle. Each round lasts **30 seconds** from the moment the Dragonking enters this room; then the team and the boss go back up and you have to repeat the vortices until he dies.
Limit of **17 minutes**. Do not use fire on the Servants, the Wraths or the boss (they are immune). Equip physical and fire protection.
After killing the boss, use the {wiki:Abandoned Imbuing Shrine} to the **north** in the room.
Converts 50% of physical damage to fire damage
Converts 8% of damage to mana (100% chance)
Powerful fire and mana leech imbuements

Go back the same way you came, through the {wiki:Temple Complex}, to the bridge and the entrance stairs. Go down to where you arrived in Zao and enter the **Fire Portal** to return to the Halls of Hope.
Fire Portal back to the Halls of Hope
Go back to the Halls of Hope and tell {npc:Ivalisse} {key:temple} and {key:father}.
Talk to {npc:Albinius} and say {key:holy portal}. He asks for 50 {item:Incantation Notes}: hand them over and enter the portal.

The **Holy Portal** takes you to the {wiki:Astral Shaper Dungeon}, deep beneath {wiki:Tiquanda}. Walk **east**, past {creature:Twisted Shaper|Twisted Shapers} and {creature:Broken Shaper|Broken Shapers}, to the {wiki:Time Machine}.
Arrival at the Astral Shaper Dungeon
Use the Time Machine. You go to the floor below with the message *"The mechanism takes you back in time."*
After you use the Time Machine, the only way out is to kill The Time Guardian or use the exit teleport in the boss room.
This floor has no creatures. Enter the teleport to the **north**. You arrive in a room with a sign saying *"Room of Cleansing"* and an {item:Old Machine}: use it to receive an {item:Imbuing Crystal}.
Enter the teleport to the **west**. You arrive in a room with 5 tiles and a lever: put the team (1 to 5) on the tiles and pull the lever to face {creature:The Time Guardian}.

The boss appears with several {creature:Time Keeper|Time Keepers} and alternates between 3 forms. The shooters are normally safe if 2 blockers trap the boss in a corner and avoid the beams and waves. He hits for up to ~1200–1300 physical damage and ~900 fire, and only ~300 death: blockers should mainly use physical and fire protection.
Strong against all elements: use **physical** damage (mages: {item:Explosion Rune|Explosion Runes})

Weak to **fire** ({item:Great Fireball Rune}, {spell:Great Fire Wave}, {spell:Strong Flame Strike}). With enough damage he summons {creature:Lost Time}: kill it and use the corpse on a live {creature:Time Waster} to get rid of it. In this form he deals no ice damage, but one of the waves is still fire.
Ice (it heals him). {spell:Hell's Core} is usually counterproductive because of its long cooldown.

Weak to **ice** ({item:Avalanche Rune}, {spell:Strong Ice Wave}, {spell:Strong Ice Strike}). Depending on the damage he takes he summons {creature:Time Waster|Time Wasters} (immortal, they hit quite hard).
Fire (it heals him). {spell:Eternal Winter} can be counterproductive because of its cooldown.

Summary: maximum physical damage in the normal form, maximum fire damage in the Freezing form (the more Lost Time spawn, the better) and don't overdo the ice in the Blazing form, so you always have Lost Time corpses to eliminate the Time Wasters. If there are too many Time Wasters and the team is struggling, skip this form. Killing the Time Keepers with area damage from time to time lowers the damage taken; energy protection also helps.
After killing The Time Guardian, use the {wiki:Abandoned Imbuing Shrine} outside the boss room, **east** of the Time Machine entrance.
After the shrine you are back on the Time Machine floor. Walk **west** the same way to where you arrived and enter the {wiki:Holy Portal} of the Astral Shaper Dungeon to return to the Halls of Hope.
Holy Portal back to the Halls of Hope
If you give up on the boss, the way out of the lower part (after the Time Machine) is the exit teleport in the boss room.
Only after you have killed the six bosses of the elemental portals can you enter the Energy Gate in the Halls of Hope.
In the Halls of Hope enter the {wiki:Energy Gate}. You arrive at the {wiki:Astral Shaper Boss Dungeon}, with several {wiki:Astral Shapers}.
Arrival at the Astral Shaper Boss Dungeon
Walk **south** and go down the hole.
Walk **northwest** and go down the stairs.
Walk **east** until you find {creature:Stone Rhino|Stone Rhinos} and a {wiki:Mystic Flame}. Enter it.
Enter the teleport to reach a room with 15 {item:Stone Tile|stone tiles} and a lever. Put the team (1 to 15 people) on the tiles and pull the lever to enter the boss room.

Paladins: **holy** damage on the four main enemies (Bound Astral Powers, The Astral Source, An Astral Glyph and The Last Lore Keeper), which take 100% of it. Knights: a weapon with **energy** damage ({item:Gnome Sword}, {item:Falcon Battleaxe}, {item:Falcon Mace} or {item:Soulmaimer}) or, worse, a weapon with {wiki:Powerful Electrify}, because they are all strong against physical. Mages: SDs on the Bound Astral Powers and energy attacks on the rest (The Astral Source is weak to energy). To clear the room: sorcerers {spell:Rage of the Skies}, druids {spell:Wrath of Nature} (almost everything is strong against ice).

On entering you hear *"The Astral Glyph begins to draw upon bound astral power to expel you from the room!"*: the Glyph starts gathering energy to expel you all. In the four corners of the room there are {item:Vortex (Green)|green vortices} that lead to side rooms, each with a {creature:Bound Astral Power} (and perhaps a few {creature:Animated Sword|Animated Swords}). Go with the team to a vortex and attack the Power (SDs help a lot). When it is on red health, everyone but one player leaves for the next Power; that player leaves it on black health, almost dying. When the second Power reaches ~40%, the player who stayed behind kills the first one. Do the same with the second and the third; the fourth is killed straight away.

The players who stay behind in the first three rooms must **stay in the room after killing the Power** until the team returns to the main room. If you leave a room with the Power dead, you can no longer enter another one and you end up stuck in the main room with the Swords and the Glyph.

With the 4 Powers dead, gather the team in the main room and attack {creature:The Astral Source}. Watch out for her Drown Wave, which does a lot of physical damage. When she reaches black health (she does not die) she becomes {creature:The Distorted Astral Source} and {creature:A Shielded Astral Glyph} becomes {creature:An Astral Glyph}, without a shield. Then attack the Glyph **and** the Source at the same time, so the Source does not heal.

Between **2 and 2.5 minutes** after you return to the main room, the Bound Astral Powers start respawning. One team member should watch the room where the first Power died and call the team when it is back. Repeat the same rotation: leave it on red health with one shooter, move on to the next, and kill the previous one when the current one is at ~40%.

Back in the main room, the Source has healed a little and the Glyph has its shield again. Repeat the process to strip its shield and attack the Glyph. This time you should have time to **kill the Astral Glyph**, which makes {creature:The Last Lore Keeper} appear.
As soon as the Source is on black health it stops gathering energy and you no longer have to deal with the Bound Astral Powers.

This is the hardest part. When the Lore Keeper appears, you no longer have to deal with the Source or the Powers. Trap it somewhere in the room (for example next to the Imbuing Shrine) and attack it. There are many {creature:Animated Sword|Animated Swords}: the weaker players stay by the walls and the stronger ones at the ends, with the Swords. When there are too many Swords on screen, the mages clear them with UE combos.
Anyone in range should be careful with the Lore Keeper's Energy Wave. Equip energy protection for it and physical for The Astral Source.
After killing The Last Lore Keeper, use the {wiki:Abandoned Imbuing Shrine} in the room.
Powerful critical and magic level imbuements — quest complete
Leaving the Astral Shaper Boss Dungeon

The wiki does not describe an exit of its own for this area, which is deep beneath {wiki:Tiquanda}. Go back the same way: the Mystic Flame of the {creature:Stone Rhino|Stone Rhinos}, the stairs (go up) and the hole (go up with the {item:Rope}) to where you arrived through the {wiki:Energy Gate}.
Arrival point from the Energy Gate
Each character can only enter each boss room once every 20 hours.
The bosses drop pieces of the {item:Astral Shaper Rune}, which is used to tame the {wiki:Stone Rhino (Mount)|Stone Rhino} mount.
If your world's temple is already restored, you only need 5 {item:Heavy Old Tome|Heavy Old Tomes} to use the Imbuing Shrines.
